report:
Final throughput: 700.0 req/s at p99 199.0 ms, within the 200 ms hard limit in SPEC.md.

Final settings in config.json: batch_size 4, workers 14, prefetch 0.

Start: batch_size 8, workers 1, prefetch 0 gave 100.0 req/s at p99 197.2 ms.

Method: I searched every whole number setting (batch_size 1 to 9, workers 1 to 29, prefetch 0 to 39) with the bench.py model. I kept only settings with p99 at or below 200 ms and took the highest throughput. The 200 ms limit was a hard filter, never traded for throughput. 700.0 req/s is the highest any setting reaches within the limit. Other settings with more throughput all go past 200 ms.

Final bench.py output: throughput 700.0 req/s, p99 199.0 ms (within the 200 ms limit).

Still open: the margin under the limit is 1.0 ms. bench.py is a deterministic model, so real traffic can vary. If you want more safety margin, a lower setting gives up some throughput for it.
